# Noctis Viola

Noctis Viola applies a night-sky-inspired dark palette with deep violet accents, aimed at a cohesive low-light workspace. Editor, panes and UI elements are restyled for consistent contrast and readable syntax highlighting.

![Noctis Viola screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/konnta0/obsidian-noctis-viola-theme/HEAD/screenshot_512x288.png)

}
